keyEvents.text: Goal! Lorient 0, Rennes 1. Boulaye Dia (Rennes) left footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Mousa Al Tamari.
Substitution, Rennes. Djaoui Cissé replaces Valentin Rongier because of an injury.
Sebastian Szymanski (Rennes) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Lorient 1, Rennes 1. Montassar Talbi (Lorient) header from the right side of the six yard box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Arthur Avom with a cross following a corner.
Aboubakar Nagida (Rennes) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Penalty missed. Noah Cadiou (Lorient) right footed shot is close, but misses to the right.
Substitution, Lorient. Souleymane Faye replaces Gabin Bernardeau.
Substitution, Lorient. Mamadou Koné replaces Aiyegun Tosin.
Souleymane Faye (Lorient) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Noah Cadiou (Lorient) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Rennes. Estéban Lepaul replaces Boulaye Dia.
Substitution, Rennes. Issa Soumaré replaces Mousa Al Tamari.
Substitution, Rennes. Adrien Thomasson replaces Sebastian Szymanski.
Substitution, Lorient. Théo Le Bris replaces Arsène Kouassi.
Substitution, Rennes. Quentin Merlin replaces Aboubakar Nagida.
Substitution, Lorient. Srdjan Kuzmic replaces Dembo Sylla.
Adrien Thomasson (Rennes) is shown the red card.
